architecture_classification.explanation: In Sprint 11.21 and 11.22, the static decision ledger (patient_decision_ledger_11_21.parquet) was generated by passively evaluating the market at 2-hour intervals (step=24 bars) under the static assumption of holding USDT cash (yielding 20,157 WAIT_USDT and 531 ENTER_BTC records). In contrast, the Portfolio Replay Simulator did NOT read from this precomputed file; it independently called evaluate_decision on-the-fly at 1-hour intervals (step=12 bars) with dynamic portfolio state. Thus, the static file was decoupled from execution. In Sprint 11.22.1, ConnectedDecisionReplayEngine establishes the direct end-to-end causal pipeline.

causal_provenance_verification.pipeline_chain: Completed Market Data -> Feature Snapshot -> Causal Regime -> Decision -> Portfolio State -> Order -> Fill

sampling_cadence_comparison.comparative_analysis: When evaluated at 2-hour cadence (step=24), trade count decreases from 627 to 403, friction drops from 9,547.29 USDT to 8363.81 USDT, and net return improves from -73.94% to -52.55%. This confirms that higher evaluation frequency in choppy regimes mechanically accelerates whipsaw churn and friction destruction.
